I just edited in the (minimal) code to do FRETRY.  Semantics
are: first arg is a pdl-ptr justt as for FRETURN, second is a
4-list as would be output by EVALFRAME except that only the
first and third items are "noticed".  Thus a form is either
evaluated after breaking up the stack, or else a function is
applied to args (after breaking up etc.).  To test it out,
there is an ITS assembled version AI:LISP:BBLISP 812QIO
